title: Reading Section A 选词填空
paperTitle: 大学英语四级标准模拟卷 04
passage:
短文：
Every city has buildings that tell its story, yet many of them disappear before residents have time to think. In the past, planners often {{1}} that old structures were simply in the way of progress. Today a different view is spreading, and heritage protection has become an {{2}} part of urban planning.

Repair is rarely cheap. A stone arch or a wooden roof may need months of work by specialists whose skills are in short {{3}}. Supporters say repair costs far less than loss. Once a building is gone, the stories attached to it are {{4}} as well.

Some cities have found {{5}} solutions. In one old district, a former textile factory became a library. Tourists come, but the {{6}} visitors are local people who use the reading rooms every day. The project also provided {{7}} work for craftsmen who might otherwise have left the area.

Critics still {{8}} that such projects mainly attract wealthy newcomers and push poorer residents out. That risk is real, and it must be {{9}} seriously. But the answer is not to demolish everything; it is to plan carefully and accept that a city without memory is {{10}} to lose its identity.

blanks.explain: 选 D. claimed（对应第 26 空）。空格需填过去式动词，claim that... 表示‘声称’，与 In the past 的时态一致。
选 F. essential（对应第 27 空）。an essential part of 意为‘……不可或缺的一部分’，与‘观念正在传播’的语境一致。
选 N. supply（对应第 28 空）。in short supply 是固定搭配，意为‘供不应求、十分稀缺’，说明掌握这类技艺的专家很少。
选 G. forgotten（对应第 29 空）。are forgotten 为被动语态，与前半句 Once a building is gone 对应，表示故事也随之被遗忘。
选 E. creative（对应第 30 空）。下文把旧纺织厂改成图书馆即为‘有创意的’做法，creative 修饰 solutions 最贴切。
选 L. regular（对应第 31 空）。regular visitors 指‘常客’，与后文‘每天都来阅览室’呼应，并与游客形成对比。
选 M. steady（对应第 32 空）。steady work 意为‘稳定的工作’，正因工作稳定，工匠才不必离开此地。
选 B. argue（对应第 33 空）。argue that 表示‘认为、主张’，此处引出批评者的观点。
选 J. handled（对应第 34 空）。be handled seriously 意为‘被认真对待、处理’，情态动词 must 后接过去分词构成被动。
选 K. likely（对应第 35 空）。be likely to do 意为‘很可能……’，作者借此强调保护城市记忆的重要性。
